mainEntity.name: How do I know if my pool needs renovation or modernization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs your pool needs renovation include visible cracks in the plaster, chipped or missing tiles, discolored or rough surfaces, outdated equipment causing high utility bills, or a general lack of aesthetic appeal. Modernization is often desired to add contemporary features, improve energy efficiency, or enhance usability for a changing lifestyle. If your pool is over 15-20 years old, experiencing frequent issues, or no longer meets your family's needs, it's likely a good candidate for an upgrade.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for cracks, chipped tiles, discolored surfaces, outdated equipment, or a general lack of appeal. If your pool is old or doesn't meet current needs, consider renovation.
